matchup.plan_md:
**Where things stand:**
- **Score after 19 Nov:** **900 to 878**, up 22.
- **Roster move recorded (ESPN sync):** Kel'el Ware dropped, **Matas Buzelis** added (free agent, 20 Nov).
- **Adds:** 4 used this matchup of 7, so **3 left**.
- **Projection with no more moves:** **1,711 to 1,576** (our lineup 811 over 20–22 Nov; theirs 698).
- **Picking up Buzelis early cost nothing.** The best plan keeping Murphy scores 918.5 now, against 919 before the pickup.

**Murphy's update:**
- **Trey Murphy III** is **questionable** for Fri at OKC with bilateral patellar tendinopathy (both knees). He has missed **six straight** games ([RotoWire, 19 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/trey-murphy-injury-iffy-for-friday-540039); [NBC Sports, 19 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-19/trey-murphy-knee-questionable-friday-vs-thunder); [NBA injury report, 19 Nov 10:45 PM ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-19_10_45PM.pdf)).
- Return: no timetable reported beyond "a chance to return Friday"; *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- No newer report exists yet; Friday's shootaround and pregame updates come out overnight Melbourne time.
- **Rest risk on Sat:** New Orleans plays Fri at OKC and Sat at SA, a back-to-back. A player returning from tendinopathy in both knees is a real candidate to sit the second night.

**The plans scored** (our lineup over 20–22 Nov; they score 698; every plan uses the 3 adds left or fewer):

| Murphy | Plan | Moves | Lineup | Final |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| **Plays Fri and Sat** | **Keep Murphy** | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (22 Nov) | **918.5** (855 + 63.5) | **about 1,819 to 1,576** |
| Plays Fri and Sat | Most points, any route | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Murphy → Queta, Bey → Mara (22 Nov) | 919.1 (811 + 108.1) | about 1,819 to 1,576 |
| Plays Fri and Sat | User-style, with Queen | Gobert → Queen, Missi → Murphy (20 Nov); Queen → Queta (22 Nov) | 888.1 (856 + 32.1) | about 1,788 to 1,576 |
| **Out Fri** | **Stream** | Gobert → Mara (20 Nov); Mara → Queta (21 Nov); Missi → Suggs (22 Nov) | **910.8** (848 + 62.8) | **about 1,811 to 1,576** |
| Out Fri, plays Sat | Add Murphy anyway | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (22 Nov) | 883.5 (820 + 63.5) | about 1,784 to 1,576 |
| Plays Fri, rests Sat | Add Murphy, keep Bey | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Missi → Queta (22 Nov) | 852.1 (820 + 32.1) | about 1,752 to 1,576 |
| Plays Fri, rests Sat | Add Murphy, drop Bey too | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Bey → Queta, Missi → Mara (22 Nov) | 883.5 (820 + 63.5) | about 1,784 to 1,576 |
| Out Fri and Sat | Add Murphy anyway, keep Bey | Gobert → Murphy (20 Nov); Missi → Queta (22 Nov) | 817.1 (785 + 32.1) | about 1,717 to 1,576 |
| — | No moves | — | 811 | 1,711 to 1,576 |

Each row is a `council/matchup.py` run with `--swap`, `--sit` and `--rotate`. The "Out Fri" stream keeps Bey, per the rule that Bey stays until Murphy is fully back.

**Verdict:**
- **Every row wins on projection.** The worst case is still about 140 ahead.
- **If Murphy plays both nights, keeping him costs 0.6 points.** Take him.
- **If he is ruled out Friday, streaming beats adding him** by about 27 points if he plays Sat, and about 94 if he misses both nights. The lead absorbs either, so adding him then is a choice between this week's cushion and having Murphy for later.
- **Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Saturday morning, Melbourne time:**
1. **Check Murphy at about 10:30–11:30 AM Sat 21.** That is New Orleans' pregame availability, 6:30–7:30 PM ET Fri, before the 12:00 PM tip.
2. **If he is playing** (available, probable, or in the starting lineup): drop **Rudy Gobert** (his next game is MIN on Sat 21 US, 12:00 PM Sun 22) and add **Trey Murphy III** before NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
3. **If he is ruled out Friday:** drop Gobert and add **Aday Mara** before the same game, NO @OKC (12:00 PM Sat 21).
   - Then drop Mara after that game and add **Neemias Queta** before BOS's Sat game (2:00 PM Sun 22).
   - Then drop **Yves Missi** after NO @SA (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22) and add **Jalen Suggs** before ORL's game (11:00 AM Mon 23).
   - Murphy stays a free agent; next week's adds can bring him in.
4. **Sunday, if Murphy played both nights:** after NO @SA (tip-off 12:00 PM Sun 22):
   - drop **Saddiq Bey**, add **Neemias Queta** before BOS @GS (12:30 PM Mon 23);
   - drop **Yves Missi**, add **Aday Mara** before OKC @MIA (10:00 AM Mon 23).
5. **Sunday, if Murphy played Fri but sat Sat:** drop only **Missi** for **Queta** (852). Dropping Bey for Mara as well adds 31 (883.5); that depends on whether one game counts as Murphy being back.

**Sunday risk:** Queta's Sunday game is the second night of Boston's road back-to-back. He has rested 1 of 4 back-to-backs. If Boston lists him out, put **Jalen Suggs** (ORL, 11:00 AM Mon 23) in his place.

**Form:**

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 | ESPN proj. |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Trey Murphy III | 35.1 | 31.0 (9) | — | 38.5 (2), small sample | 31.0 (9) | 36.8 |
| Rudy Gobert | 25.6 | 25.4 (15) | 22.4 (5) | 26.6 (8) | 25.4 (15) | 34.3 |
| Saddiq Bey | 34.9 ‡ (rate 34.8) | 30.4 (16) | 41.0 (4) | 33.0 (9) | 30.4 (16) | 25.9 |
| Yves Missi | 27.6 | 32.0 (5) | 25.7 (3) | 25.7 (3) | 32.0 (5) | 24.7 |
| Matas Buzelis | 32.0 | 25.5 (14) | 38.2 (4) | 32.0 (7) | 25.5 (14) | 32.5 |
| Neemias Queta | 32.1 | 27.3 (14) | 38.0 (2), small sample | 30.4 (7) | 27.3 (14) | 27.2 |
| Aday Mara | 31.4 | 27.1 (15) | 34.3 (3) | 33.1 (8) | 27.1 (15) | — |
| Jalen Suggs | 30.0 ‡ (rate 35.8) | 26.7 (6) → 31.2 (5) | 27.0 (3) → 38.5 (2), small sample | 27.0 (3) → 38.5 (2), small sample | 26.7 (6) → 31.2 (5) | 29.2 |

L30 equals the season average for everyone so far. Suggs' 4-FP game on 13 Nov is dropped as an outlier (bad game).

**Why the L7s are 5+ off the season:**
- **Bey, +10.6:** starting at 37.8 min (29.6 for the season) with Murphy out.
- **Buzelis, +12.8:** starting with Caleb Wilson out (*ESPN est.* 13 Dec).
- **Mara, +7.2:** about 25 min with Chet Holmgren out (*ESPN est.* 2 Jan).
- **Queta, +10.7:** two games, a small sample.
- **Missi, −6.3:** minutes unchanged (20.7, against 20.2); no other reason found. He has played only five games this season.

**Snow Time Lakers:**
